events.text:
No evidence found in britannica. The 1771–1797 Encyclopaedia Britannica has no entry on Neptune.

I searched the Britannica side for "Neptune" (planet) and "Neptune god sea mythology"; both searches returned only low-confidence, unrelated matches (headwords like HUESNE, ATE, DANAE, ENDYMON), with top scores of 0.155 and 0.242 — below the 0.3 confidence heuristic, flagged `low_confidence: true`.

This is historically expected: the planet Neptune was not discovered until 1846, decades after this Britannica edition (1st–3rd editions, 1768–1797), and the search found no Britannica entry on the Roman god Neptune either.

Citations checked: [B:1327:3], [B:1845:0], [B:2171:6], [B:1430:0], [B:1904:0], [B:1214:3], [B:523:5] — none concern Neptune.
